title: TabMosaic: Unified In-Context Diffusion for Tabular Generative Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2610.15699v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generative modeling for tabular data has advanced to the point where models can synthesize realistic records, recover missing values, and generate samples conditioned on class labels or observed attributes. Despite recent advances, existing approaches either require table-specific training or restrict in-context learning to single-cell prediction. In this work, we formulate these tabular generative tasks as a single problem: modeling the joint conditional distribution of an arbitrary set of target cells given the observed cells of an unseen table. To this end, we turn to diffusion, whose denoising objective is defined jointly over all target cells rather than one cell at a time. Under the pretraining distribution, this objective is minimized by the posterior predictive distribution over the target set. Building on this, we propose TabMosaic, a unified in-context diffusion model for generating mixed-type target cells in unseen, potentia

translated_title: TabMosaic：面向表格生成任务的统一上下文扩散模型
translated_abstract: 表格数据的生成建模已发展到相当成熟的阶段：模型能够合成逼真的记录、恢复缺失值，并生成以类别标签或观测属性为条件的样本。然而尽管近期进展显著，现有方法要么需要针对特定表格进行训练，要么将上下文学习限制在单单元格预测上。在这项工作中，我们将这些表格生成任务统一表述为一个单一问题：在给定未见表格中已观测单元格的条件下，建模任意目标单元格集合的联合条件分布。为此，我们采用扩散模型，其去噪目标是在所有目标单元格上联合定义的，而非一次仅针对单个单元格。在预训练分布下，该目标由目标集合上的后验预测分布实现最小化。基于此，我们提出了TabMosaic——一个统一的上下文扩散模型，用于在未见表格中生成混合类型的目标单元格（摘要在此处不完整）。
tldr: TabMosaic将合成记录、缺失值填补、条件生成等多种表格生成任务统一为“给定未见表格中已观测单元格时对任意目标单元格集合的联合条件分布建模”这一单一问题，提出一个无需表格特定训练的统一上下文扩散模型。
en_tdlr: TabMosaic unifies diverse tabular generative tasks into a single problem of modeling the joint conditional distribution of arbitrary target cell sets given observed cells from unseen tables, via a unified in-context diffusion model that requires no table-specific training.
